name: the telling clause not shown in keeping: interference seen, its cause and loss not
what_it_changes: As in F07, P05's added clause holds only in part, here in watching, repairing and defending: interference with a planned change is seen, but who was told, whether keepers knew, and whether the change was lost for want of telling are not, and informed disagreement also occurs.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/restrict_P05_T4-013.txt, state one shared change to P05. R1a: T3-005 holds 14 of the 27 rooms and T3-021 11, so the branch is declared at the fourth order. 'Wrong repairs establish distorted upkeep but not obsolete keeper knowledge or failed communication reversing an agreed change' (lakers); 'Telling keepers about a change does not itself establish acceptance' (radiohead). One line is armok's re-check correction (F-024). These are the labelers' how sentences.
